description: Manually curated benchmark containing 26 contractual obligations with ground-truth actor, action, trigger, condition, deadline, and source clause attribution.
clauses_evaluated: Clause 3 — Monthly Rent and Late Fees
Clause 5 — Utility Bills and Municipal Outgoings
Clause 8 — Landlord Right of Inspection and Entry
Clause 11 — Surrender of Premises and Key Handover
Clause 12 — Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

benchmark_obligations.action: Pay monthly rent
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Beginning of each calendar rental month
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: on or before the 5th day of each calendar month
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Late payment penalty of ₹500 per day of delay
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a monthly rent of ₹20,000 on or before the 5th day of each calendar month in advance.

benchmark_obligations.action: Pay late payment penalty
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Failure to pay rent on or before the 5th day
benchmark_obligations.condition: If rent remains unpaid beyond the 5th day
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: immediately upon demand or with next installment
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Cumulative interest and default notice
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: In the event of default, the Tenant agrees to pay a late fee of ₹500 per day until the entire outstanding amount is remitted.

benchmark_obligations.action: Deposit interest-free security amount
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Execution of this agreement
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: upon signing of this agreement
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Non-delivery of possession of the premises
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall deposit and maintain with the Landlord an interest-free refundable security deposit of ₹60,000 upon execution of this agreement.

benchmark_obligations.action: Refund security deposit
benchmark_obligations.trigger: End of tenancy and peaceful surrender of premises
benchmark_obligations.condition: Subject to permitted deductions for unpaid rent, utilities, or documented structural damage
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: within 30 days following the handover of peaceful vacant possession
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Statutory interest penalty of 9% per annum on withheld amount
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Landlord shall refund the security deposit within 30 days following the peaceful surrender of the premises, subject to permitted deductions.

benchmark_obligations.action: Pay utility charges
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Receipt of respective utility invoices
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: within 7 days of receiving the respective invoice or bill
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Disconnection penalty and Landlord settlement recovery
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall promptly pay all charges for electricity, water, and high-speed internet consumed within 7 days of receiving the respective bill.

benchmark_obligations.action: Furnish utility payment receipts to Landlord
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Remittance of utility billing amount
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: no later than the 10th of each calendar month
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Assumption of non-payment
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall furnish copies of paid utility receipts to the Landlord upon request no later than the 10th of each month.

benchmark_obligations.action: Complete major structural and plumbing repairs
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Tenant reports qualifying major defect in writing
benchmark_obligations.condition: Damage not caused by willful negligence of Tenant
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: within 7 days of written notification from the Tenant
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Tenant right to repair and deduct reasonable costs from subsequent rent
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Landlord shall complete necessary major structural and plumbing repairs within 7 days of written notification from the Tenant.

benchmark_obligations.action: Maintain minor fixtures and cleanliness
benchmark_obligations.object: Internal fixtures, light bulbs, minor drain cleanings
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Daily occupancy
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: throughout the subsistence of the tenancy
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Deduction from security deposit upon vacating
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant is responsible for day-to-day cleanliness and minor repairs of fuses, tap washers, and fittings at their own expense.

benchmark_obligations.action: Use premises exclusively for residential dwelling
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Duration of lease
benchmark_obligations.condition: No commercial or illicit activities permitted
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: throughout the lease term
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Immediate contract termination without refund of balance rent
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant agrees to use the premises strictly for private residential accommodation and shall not operate any commercial enterprise.

benchmark_obligations.clause_title: Landlord Right of Inspection and Entry
benchmark_obligations.action: Provide advance notice prior to inspection
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Desire to enter and inspect physical condition of premises
benchmark_obligations.condition: Except in life-threatening or property emergencies
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: at least 24 hours prior written notice
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Tenant refusal permitted
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Landlord or their authorized agent shall give at least 24 hours prior written notice before entering the premises for inspection.

benchmark_obligations.clause_title: Landlord Right of Inspection and Entry
benchmark_obligations.action: Permit reasonable inspection access
benchmark_obligations.object: Dwelling access during reasonable daylight hours
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Receipt of valid 24-hour inspection notice
benchmark_obligations.condition: During daylight hours between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: at the mutually agreed inspection appointment
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Breach of tenancy terms
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall permit inspection access during reasonable daylight hours following due notice.

benchmark_obligations.action: Obtain prior written consent before structural alteration
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Intention to drill, paint, or modify structural partitions
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: prior to commencing any modification work
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Obligation to restore premises to original condition at Tenant's sole expense
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall not carry out any structural alterations or wall repaintings without prior written consent from the Landlord.

benchmark_obligations.action: Provide written notice of termination
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Intention to terminate agreement prior to natural expiry
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: at least 30 days prior to the proposed termination date
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Forfeiture of one month's rent in lieu of notice
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days prior written notice to the Landlord.

benchmark_obligations.action: Provide written notice of termination
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Intention to repossess or terminate lease
benchmark_obligations.condition: Subject to minimum lock-in period of 3 months
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: at least 30 days prior to the desired move-out date
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Tenancy continues under original terms
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Landlord may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days written notice to the Tenant.

benchmark_obligations.clause_title: Surrender of Premises and Key Handover
benchmark_obligations.action: Hand over keys and vacant possession
benchmark_obligations.object: Keys, access fobs, and clean premises
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Date of lease termination
benchmark_obligations.condition: Premises returned in reasonably clean condition, normal wear and tear excepted
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: no later than 12:00 PM on the final day of the tenancy
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Unauthorized holding over charge of ₹2,000 per calendar day
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall surrender vacant possession and return all keys to the Landlord by 12:00 PM on the expiration date.

benchmark_obligations.action: Attempt amicable conciliation before litigation
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Any controversy or claim arising under this agreement
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: within 15 days of written notice of dispute
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Referral to sole arbitrator under Arbitration and Conciliation Act
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: Both parties agree to resolve any dispute through amicable conciliation within 15 days prior to initiating formal arbitration.

benchmark_obligations.action: Pay statutory property tax and society capital funds
benchmark_obligations.object: Property tax and society sinking fund
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Statutory assessment by municipal corporation
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: upon issuance by municipal authorities
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Municipal attachment risk
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Landlord shall remain solely liable for statutory property tax and building capital society sinking funds.

benchmark_obligations.action: Obtain written approval prior to subletting
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Desire to assign or share possession
benchmark_obligations.condition: Strictly subject to prior written approval from Landlord
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: prior to parting with possession
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Immediate contract termination without notice
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or part with possession of the premises to any third party without prior written approval.

benchmark_obligations.action: Execute fresh written agreement for renewal
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Intention to extend lease beyond 11 months
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: at least 30 days prior to the expiration of ongoing term
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Automatic termination on expiry date
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: Any renewal shall require a fresh written agreement executed at least 30 days prior to the expiration of the ongoing term.

benchmark_obligations.action: Restore premises to pristine original condition
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Carrying out unapproved structural alterations or wall painting
benchmark_obligations.condition: If unapproved modifications were made during tenancy
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: prior to final vacation
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Cost recovery deducted from security deposit
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: The Tenant shall restore the premises to its pristine original condition at the Tenant's sole expense prior to final vacation.

benchmark_obligations.clause_title: Surrender of Premises and Key Handover
benchmark_obligations.action: Pay unauthorized holding over daily charge
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Failure to vacate premises by 12:00 PM on expiration date
benchmark_obligations.condition: Until actual vacant possession is delivered
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: calculated daily until actual possession is delivered
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Forcible eviction and legal damages
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: If the Tenant fails to vacate upon expiry or termination, the Tenant shall pay an unauthorized holding over charge of ₹2,000 per calendar day.

benchmark_obligations.action: Exercise immediate termination upon prolonged default
benchmark_obligations.trigger: Continued default in rent payment exceeding 15 days
benchmark_obligations.condition: Rent remains unpaid after 15 days from due date
benchmark_obligations.deadline_text: upon 15 days of continued default
benchmark_obligations.consequence: Immediate eviction notice and repossession
benchmark_obligations.evidence_text: Continued default exceeding 15 days shall constitute grounds for immediate termination.

When must the security deposit be returned?
What happens if rent is paid late?
How much notice is required for termination?
